ui.admin.chars.les_pv_et_l_attaque: HP and base attack are calculated from the stats. Available spells depend on the chosen class (see the Classes tab).
ui.admin.chars.ce_tableau_definit_la_config: This table defines each character's starting configuration, at the very beginning of the game — not their in-progress state. ui.admin.class_talents.talents_choix_a_un_p: 🌟 Talents (a choice at each level tier, one per character of this class)
ui.admin.class_talents.inaccessible_evolue_: — ⚠️ unreachable: %s evolves at level %d, only the advanced class's talents will count from then on
ui.admin.classes.chaque_classe_determine_le: Each class determines the weapon types and spells a character of that class can use.
ui.admin.classes.sorts_autorises_via_attrib: Allowed spells (via manual assignment or scroll)
ui.admin.classes.sorts_capacites_maximum_au: ❌ %s: maximum of %d spells/abilities allowed per class (fixed cap, can never be exceeded — a character can never know more anyway).
ui.admin.classes.aucune_progression_definie: No progression defined — allowed spells remain to be assigned manually or via scroll.
ui.admin.classes.cette_classe_apprend_deja_: This class already learns this spell at this exact level.
ui.admin.classes.impossible_a_deja_atteint_: Impossible: %s has already reached its maximum of %d allowed spells/abilities. Remove one before adding this one to the progression.
ui.admin.classes.voies_evolution_classes_ev: Evolution paths: advanced classes whose dependency points to this base class.
ui.admin.classes.il_doit_rester_au_moins: At least one class must remain.
ui.admin.classes.une_classe_evoluee_n_est: An advanced class can only be reached by evolving from the base class chosen here.
ui.admin.general.protection_basique_cote_ap: ⚠️ Basic device-side protection: prevents accidental access, this is not production-grade security.
ui.admin.general.limite_de_temps_par_tour: ⏳ Turn time limit (auto-passes the turn otherwise)
ui.admin.general.evite_qu_un_joueur_attende: Prevents a player from waiting indefinitely for a spell cooldown before acting. Applies to characters and monsters alike (red bar under the Flee button in combat).
ui.admin.general.applique_a_tous_les_person: Applies to all characters. Stamina increases when a hero is hit, and decreases when attacking (weapon or spell).
ui.admin.general.l_endurance_maximale_se_re: Maximum stamina is now set individually for each character in the « Characters » tab.
ui.admin.general.plafonne_a_2_points_maximu: Capped at 2 points maximum regardless of this setting: the basic physical attack must never fully block a character who is out of stamina.
ui.admin.general.le_cout_en_endurance_des: The stamina cost of spells/abilities is now set individually in the « Spells / Abilities » tab.
ui.admin.general.ex_gain_de_1_tous: E.g.: gain of 1 every 3 moves = slower regeneration. Randomly generated dungeons use this stricter interval by default.
ui.admin.general.en_dessous_du_cout_requis: Below the required cost, a spell or ability is blocked until stamina recovers (the basic physical attack, however, always remains possible — see the note above).
ui.admin.general.bonus_endurance_a_la_fin: Stamina bonus at the end of a fight, as a % of each character's max stamina — varies with the difficulty chosen in a random dungeon (the Original Dungeon and hand-made dungeons use the “Normal” value).
ui.admin.general.regeneration_partielle_de_: Partial HP/stamina regeneration on first arrival on a level (stairs/archway), as a % of max — granted only once per level and per game.
ui.admin.general.a_chaque_niveau_gagne_par: Each time a character gains a level, their base stats (Strength/Dexterity/Constitution/Intelligence) and base stamina increase slightly — HP and damage benefit indirectly (via Constitution/Strength), on top of their own level-based progression.
ui.admin.general.stats_de_base_points_cumul: Base stats — points accumulated per level
ui.admin.general.ex_0_4_force_dex: E.g. 0.4 = Str/Dex/Con/Int increase together by +1 every 2-3 levels (fractional accumulation, never lost).
ui.admin.general.cout_en_or_demande_par: Cost (in gold) asked by the Talent Master to change an already chosen talent — increases with the tier concerned (×1 at level 5, ×5 at level 25).
ui.admin.general.placees_dans_les_niveaux_t: Placed in levels (item type « Fountain »), they fully restore HP and stamina for the whole party, then need this delay to recharge.
ui.admin.general.chance_de_desamorcer_un_pi: Chance for the whole party (living characters) to disarm a trap. A natural 20 always succeeds, a natural 1 always fails.
ui.admin.general.dexterite_prise_en_compte_: Dexterity counted (max points above 10, per character)
ui.admin.general.degats_un_piege_pourcentag: Trap damage: percentage of the hit character's max HP (chosen at random). The fixed damage set on each trap acts as a guaranteed minimum.
ui.admin.general.degats_un_piege_minimum_de: Trap damage — minimum (% of max HP)
ui.admin.general.degats_un_piege_maximum_de: Trap damage — maximum (% of max HP)
ui.admin.general.applique_aux_donjons_gener: Applies to randomly generated dungeons: chance that a boss's guaranteed loot is a legendary item (unique name, boosted stats, special bonus). Legendary items can also be set manually on any weapon/armor/jewelry, in the Base items and Levels tabs.
ui.admin.general.la_mort_un_monstre_reparti: A monster's death splits its XP among all characters who contributed to the fight (damage dealt, but also healing given), proportionally. The ratio below determines how many healed HP count as 1 damage point for this calculation — useful for valuing healing skills and spells.
ui.admin.general.la_configuration_personnag: The configuration (characters, classes, spells, levels, monsters, items, title) is separate from a game's progress.
ui.admin.general.reinitialiser_toute_la_con: Reset the whole configuration to default values?
ui.admin.general.alternative_a_l_export_imp: An alternative to file export/import: a long text code containing the whole configuration, to copy-paste directly (in a conversation, a message...) with no file to attach.

ui.admin.levels.rayon_de_deplacement_automa: Automatic movement radius around its starting position (0=static)
ui.admin.levels.rapidite_attaque_automatiqu: Automatic attack rate: time between two attacks (1s = very fast, 3s = slow)

This dungeon is a demo: a fixed 3-level run designed to introduce the main mechanics (combat, locked doors, fountain, items, levelling up…).

ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_8_q: The more I dry, the wetter I get. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_9_q: I die the moment you speak my name. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_10_q: The hotter I am, the fresher I am. What am I?

ui.ui.settings.title: ⚙ Settings
ui.ui.settings.preset_hint_auto: At each launch, the game measures this machine and sets the quality to aim for at least 60 frames per second with standard (1024) textures. It only goes lower if needed, and only goes higher when there is real headroom.
ui.ui.settings.preset_hint_low: For modest machines and phones: lighter rendering, few lights and effects.
ui.ui.settings.preset_hint_medium: A good balance between smoothness and looks.
ui.ui.settings.preset_hint_high: Full rendering: torch and spell lights, anti-aliasing, sharp textures.
ui.ui.settings.preset_hint_ultra: Everything maxed out: supersampled image, abundant effects. Needs a good graphics card.
ui.ui.settings.preset_hint_custom: Every option is set by hand; automatic adaptation is turned off.
ui.ui.settings.adapt_hint: If the game drops below the target frame rate, quality goes down one notch; it goes back up when the machine keeps up. The level chosen above is the ceiling.
ui.ui.settings.tex_note: The texture set changes on the next level loaded. Only the PC version ships the 2048 textures.
ui.ui.settings.win_hint: F11 or Alt+Enter also switches between the two; the choice is remembered.
ui.ui.settings.fps_cap_hint: A lower limit saves battery and reduces heat.
ui.ui.settings.display_web_note: In the browser, the window and sync are handled by the browser itself.
ui.ui.settings.reduced_motion_hint: Softens the flicker of flames and lights.
ui.ui.settings.diag_perf: Show the FPS / RAM / VRAM counter (F3)

ui.ui.chat.charte_intro: Before you come in, read and accept the chat rules. They apply to every room.
ui.ui.chat.charte_updated: The chat charter has changed. Please read it again and accept it to continue.
ui.ui.chat.charte_1: Respect: no insults, harassment, threats or discriminatory remarks towards a player or a group.
ui.ui.chat.charte_2: No shocking, sexual or illegal content, and no advertising, spam or dubious links.
ui.ui.chat.charte_3: Do not share any personal information (address, phone, e-mail…), neither yours nor anyone else's.
ui.ui.chat.charte_4: Do not pretend to be another player or the administration, and do not deliberately disrupt the rooms (repeated messages, flooding).
ui.ui.chat.charte_5: Your messages are visible to all signed-in players; they are kept for 30 days then deleted, and erased with your account if you delete it.
ui.ui.chat.charte_6: Messages can be reported. The administrator may delete a message or mute you, temporarily, in case of abuse. An automatic filter and a rate limit apply.
ui.ui.chat.charte_7: You can block a player at any time: their messages disappear for you.
ui.ui.chat.charte_footer: Accepting the charter is required to read and write in the chat. It may change: you will then see it again once.
ui.ui.cloud.err.charte_non_acceptee: You must accept the chat charter first.
ui.ui.cloud.err.charte_obsolete: The charter has changed: read it again before accepting.
ui.ui.hub.title: Online mode
ui.ui.hub.offline_text: Sign in to play ranked, earn experience and badges, and chat with other players. Free play stays available without an account.
ui.ui.hub.need_account: An account is required for this mode.
ui.ui.hub.tag_free: A dungeon your way, no constraints
ui.ui.hub.tag_ranked: Same rules for all, verified score
ui.ui.hub.tag_hardcore: One dungeon a month, one attempt a day
ui.ui.hub.free_desc: Generate a random dungeon to your taste (size, difficulty, heroes) and play at your own pace. The ideal mode to practise.
ui.ui.hub.free_board: Your best run is sent automatically to the open challenge (declared, unverified score) as soon as a level is cleared.
ui.ui.hub.free_quit: Any time. The levels already cleared are sent to the ranking; nothing is lost.
ui.ui.hub.free_editor: Allowed. But a run where the editor was used is no longer sent to the ranking.
ui.ui.hub.free_home: To start a free game, go back to the home screen.
ui.ui.hub.ranked_desc: The server picks the dungeon and replays your run to recompute your score: no cheating, no being unfairly overtaken.
ui.ui.hub.ranked_dungeon: Each run: 3 levels, 13 × 11 dungeon. The higher the difficulty, the more XP per level.
ui.ui.hub.ranked_fair: The dungeon is drawn by the server; your run is recorded action by action then replayed identically.
ui.ui.hub.ranked_board: Score = levels cleared; on a tie, the fastest. Only your best verified run of each difficulty counts.
ui.ui.hub.ranked_quit: Any time: “Finish here” sends your run as it stands (levels already cleared count), “Pause” saves it for a single resume.
ui.ui.hub.ranked_reward: 40 XP × levels cleared × difficulty multiplier, for each verified run.
ui.ui.hub.ranked_forbidden: Editor, export, import and old saves: the run then becomes unrankable (it plays, but is not sent).
ui.ui.hub.ranked_tries: Unlimited. Starting a new run abandons the previous unfinished one.
ui.ui.hub.ranked_confirm: Difficulty: %s. The server picks the dungeon. You can stop at any time: “Finish here” sends your run as it stands, “Pause” saves it (single resume). Editor, export, import and old saves are forbidden. Continue?
ui.ui.hub.hc_desc: The month's challenge: everyone faces exactly the same dungeon, at maximum difficulty. Replay-verified, ranked at the end of the month, with badges and titles to win.
ui.ui.hub.hc_dungeon: A single dungeon for all players: 5 levels, Hardcore difficulty, seed drawn by the server at the month's first run.
ui.ui.hub.hc_tries: ONE attempt per day (Paris day). It is used up at launch, even if you give up.
ui.ui.hub.hc_quit: Any time: “Finish here” sends your run as it stands (levels already cleared), “Pause” saves it for a single resume. The daily attempt stays used.
ui.ui.hub.hc_board: Monthly ranking on verified runs; your best attempt counts.
ui.ui.hub.hc_reward: XP for each verified attempt and each milestone, participation and depth badges, then rank badges when the month closes.
ui.ui.hub.hc_play: Play the Hardcore (1 attempt a day)
ui.ui.hub.hc_confirm: Your daily attempt is used up at launch, even if you give up. You can stop at any time: “Finish here” sends your run as it stands, “Pause” saves it (single resume). Editor, export, import and old saves are forbidden. Continue?
ui.ui.hub.hc_used: Daily attempt already used: come back tomorrow.
ui.ui.hub.hc_unknown: Could not check your daily attempt right now: the server will tell you at launch.
ui.ui.hub.bd_free: Open challenge — scores declared by the game (unverified). Hover a name for details.
ui.ui.hub.bd_ranked: Ranked runs — replay-verified runs only, one best run per player.
ui.ui.hub.not_ranked: You are not in this ranking yet.
ui.ui.hub.xp_how: XP comes from verified ranked runs. It has no effect on gameplay.
ui.ui.hub.runs_intro: Your latest ranked runs and their state. A sent run is verified within a few minutes.
ui.ui.hub.runs_need_account: Sign in to see your ranked runs.
ui.ui.hub.runs_none: No ranked run yet. Start one from the “Play” tab!
ui.ui.hub.runs_legend: In progress: started, not sent yet · Pending: sent, being verified · Verified: score validated · Rejected: replay failed · Expired: abandoned.
ui.ui.leave.ranked_intro: You can stop at any time. Here is what each choice means:
ui.ui.leave.hc_note: Monthly Hardcore: the daily attempt is already used up, whatever you choose.
ui.ui.leave.free_sent: Your progress (%d level(s) cleared) is sent automatically to the challenge ranking.
ui.ui.leave.opt_save_d: Pick a slot and resume the game later.
ui.ui.leave.opt_export_d: Writes the dungeon and the game to a JSON file.
ui.ui.leave.opt_code_d: Generates a code to share this dungeon.
ui.ui.leave.opt_pause_d: The run is saved and stays in progress. It can be resumed only once.
ui.ui.leave.opt_finish_d: The run is sent as it stands and verified: only cleared levels count. No resuming.
ui.ui.leave.opt_abandon_d: No level cleared: nothing will be ranked. No resuming.
ui.ui.hub.tag_weekly: A special rule every week, unlimited tries
ui.ui.hub.weekly_desc: Every week, everyone faces the same dungeon with a special rule that changes how you play. Unlimited tries, ranking verified by replay.
ui.ui.hub.weekly_dungeon: The same dungeon for everyone: 4 levels, Normal difficulty, drawn by the server at the week's first run.
ui.ui.hub.weekly_tries: Unlimited tries: only your best result counts. Starting a new run abandons the previous unfinished one.
ui.ui.hub.weekly_quit: Any time, no penalty: “Pause” (single resume) or “Finish here” (cleared levels kept). You can start again.
ui.ui.hub.weekly_board: Weekly ranking: levels cleared, then time. Verified by replay.
ui.ui.hub.weekly_reward: XP for every run, +100 XP the first time each week, a badge and +250 XP for clearing all 4 levels with the rule, rank badges when the week closes.

content.content.charger_un_donjon_depuis_un: 🔑 Load a dungeon from a code
content.content.collez_ci_dessous_le_code: Paste the code you received below: it contains the whole dungeon (characters, classes, spells, levels, items). A new game starts directly with this configuration.
content.content.protection_basique_cote_navigate: ⚠️ Basic browser-side protection: prevents accidental access, this is not production-grade security.
content.content.la_configuration_personnages: The configuration (characters, classes, spells, levels, monsters, items, title) is separate from a game's progress. « Save » and « Export » below also work once the file is downloaded and opened locally.
content.content.ce_donjon_sert_de_demonstration:
This dungeon is a demonstration: a fixed 3-level course designed to discover the game's main mechanics (combat, locked doors, fountain, items, level-ups…).

To explore everything the game really offers, launch a random dungeon from the home screen instead.

Start this demonstration?
content.content.un_nouveau_donjon_de_depart: A new starting dungeon will be generated and will replace the current administration configuration. Continue?
content.content.la_configuration_a_ete_enregistr: The configuration has been saved. It can be edited in the administration.
content.content.ce_fichier_ne_contient_pas: This file does not contain a recognized save.
content.content.jeter_definitivement_cette_actio: Permanently discard %s? This action is irreversible, the item will be lost.
content.content.le_contenu_n_est_pas: The content is not a valid configuration file.
content.content.configuration_incomplete_niveaux: Incomplete configuration (levels, classes or party missing).
content.content.les_classes_de_base_guerrier: Base classes (Warrior, Archer, Rogue, Mage, Priest, Bard) evolve into advanced classes, each depending on a base class. Allowed weapons, allowed spells, per-level progression and talents are set here.
content.content.chacune_depend_une_classe_de: Each depends on a base class from which it inherits weapons.
content.content.sorts_autorises_attribution_manu: Allowed spells (manual assignment or scroll) — %d maximum
content.content.aucune_progression_definie_les: No progression defined: allowed spells remain to be assigned manually or via scroll.
content.content.cette_classe_apprend_deja_ce: This class already learns this spell at this level.
content.content.a_deja_sorts_autorises_retirez: %s already has %d allowed spells: remove one before adding to the progression.
content.content.voies_evolution_classes_evoluees: Evolution paths: advanced classes whose dependency points to this base class.
content.content.inaccessible_evolue_au_niveau: — unreachable: %s evolves at level %d, only the advanced class's talents count afterwards
content.content.pour_une_classe_evoluee_classe: For an advanced class: the base class it depends on
content.content.choisissez_un_mot_de_passe: Choose a password of at least 4 characters.
content.content.une_partie_est_en_cours: A game is in progress. Your changes will apply to the next game; resuming keeps the dungeon as it was.
content.content.tous_les_sorts_et_competences: All the game's spells and abilities. Classes then choose which ones they can use (« Classes » tab).
content.content.cliquez_sur_la_carte_pour: Click on the map to place:
content.content.desactive_temporairement_la_regl: Temporarily disables the « one-cell-wide corridors » rule.
content.content.cliquez_ou_faites_glisser_pour: Click or drag to paint. The badges in the corners indicate a monster (top left) or an item (bottom right): click on it to remove it from the level.
content.content.un_monstre_ne_peut_pas: A monster cannot be placed within 3 cells of a staircase: the player must never run into a fight when changing level.
content.content.determine_l_ordre_de_passage: Determines the order in the initiative queue, not the attack rate.
content.content.monstre_de_fin_de_niveau: End-of-level monster, imposing display (incompatible with a group).
content.content.apparait_en_groupe_de_2: Appears as a group of 2 or 3 (incompatible with a boss).
content.content.cache_tant_qu_un_interrupteur: Hidden until a switch reveals it (or reserved for a monster's loot)
content.content.aucun_escalier_sur_ce_niveau: No staircase on this level yet. Paint a staircase on the map, then choose its destination here.
content.content.laissez_y_vides_pour_arriver: Leave X/Y empty to arrive at the level's starting point. For a round trip, add a second staircase in the target level set to come back here.
content.content.emplacements_laisses_vides_le: Slots left empty: the merchant will offer a random item instead, like the automatically generated traveling merchant.
content.content.evite_qu_un_joueur_attende: Prevents a player from waiting indefinitely for a spell cooldown to end before acting. Applies to characters and monsters alike (red bar under the Flee button).
content.content.applique_a_tous_les_personnages: Applies to all characters. Stamina increases when a hero is hit, and decreases when they attack (weapon or spell). Max stamina is set for each character in the « Characters » tab, spell cost in « Spells / Abilities ».
content.content.endurance_recuperee_apres_chaque: Stamina recovered after each victory, as a % of the maximum, depending on the dungeon's difficulty.
content.content.a_chaque_niveau_gagne_les: With each level gained, base stats (Strength/Dexterity/Constitution/Intelligence) and base stamina increase slightly — HP and damage benefit indirectly.
content.content.placees_dans_les_niveaux_objet: Placed in the levels (« Fountain » item), they fully restore HP and stamina of the whole party, then recharge after this delay.
content.content.dexterite_prise_en_compte_max: Dexterity taken into account (max points above 10)
content.content.applique_aux_donjons_generes: Applies to randomly generated dungeons: chance that a boss's guaranteed loot is a legendary item (unique name, boosted stats, special bonus: Life steal, Critical, Reflect).
content.content.la_mort_un_monstre_repartit: A monster's death splits its XP between all characters who contributed to the fight (damage dealt, but also healing done), proportionally. This ratio sets how many HP healed are worth 1 point of damage in this calculation.
content.content.alternative_a_l_export_import: Alternative to file export/import: a long text code containing the whole configuration, to copy-paste directly (in a chat, a message…) with no file to attach.
content.content.coller_ci_dessous_un_code: Paste a received code below to load this dungeon into the administration (replaces the current configuration):
content.content.le_groupe_qui_demarre_l: The party that starts the adventure. Spells marked with a padlock are learned automatically at a given level (class progression) and cannot be assigned at the start. Maximum %d spells per character.
content.content.sorts_et_competences_connus_au: Spells and abilities known at the start
content.content.cette_classe_n_a_aucun: This class has no allowed spell.
content.content.la_bibliotheque_objets_equipemen: The item library: characters' starting equipment, loot, shops. Items placed in levels are set in the « Levels » tab.
content.content.le_groupe_prend_la_fuite_chacun_: The party flees! Everyone loses half their stamina in the rush.
content.content.un_marchand_ambulant_vous_salue_: A traveling merchant greets you and sets up their stall.
content.content.une_cle_ne_peut_jamais_etre_jete: A key can never be discarded — it might still be needed.
content.content.ajouter_un_marchand_ambulant_sur: Add a traveling merchant on this level
content.content.retirer_le_marchand_de_ce_niveau: Remove the merchant from this level
content.content.protection_basique_cote_appareil: Basic device-side protection: avoids accidental access, this is not production security.
content.content.code_copie_dans_le_presse_papier: Code copied to the clipboard (%d characters).
content.content.une_presence_protectrice_emane_d: A protective presence emanates from the stone.
